method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs and street-name labels
why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 45 prints '23RD OR TREMONT ST.' (block faces native y 2401 and 2643, a 242 px = 80 ft corridor) and '24TH ST.' at its lower edge; sheet 51 prints '24TH ST.' at its upper edge with the adjoining-sheet numeral '45' beside it, so 24th is the shared line. The avenue-frontage hundred-block steps across it: sheet 45's blocks between 23rd and 24th carry 2301 2303 ... 2327 / 2302 2304 ... 2328, sheet 51's blocks carry 2401 2403 ... 2421 / 2402 2404 ... 2422. The 24th St frontage runs face each other across the corridor - 1302 1304 1306 ... 1332, 1402 ... 1416 on sheet 45's south block faces and 1301 1303 1305 ... 1331, 1401 1403 ... 1413 on sheet 51's north block faces - which is only possible at the same street. Outlot 17 confirms it: sheet 45 labels 'N.E. 17' and 'S.E. 17', sheet 51 'N.W. 17' and 'S.W. 17', i.e. the east and west halves of one outlot split by 24th St. Positions: sheet 45's north face of the corridor at native y 3549, centre 3670 (half of 242); sheet 51's south face at native y 289, centre 168 (its north face is trimmed by the scan edge at ~51). Candidates 2981 (sheet 45, block interior between 23rd and 24th) rejected; sheet 51's 214 lay in the corridor but off centre.
